newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APP Global Finance prices and increases US$ FRN.
newsitem.headline: APP Global Finance prices and increases US$ FRN.

text.p: APP Global Finance's floating rate note issue has been priced at par to float at 425 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate, arranger Peregrine Fixed Income said Friday.
Peregrine also said the issue size has been raised to US$500 million from US$400 million. Syndication will close next Monday.
The issue was launched in mid-March.
